tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Quotation for Supplying and installation of a solar street lighting system

itemList.description: Supplying and installation of a solar street lighting system comprising a 12 V/30 W LED luminaire, designed for 12 hours of operation per day with a minimum autonomy of 2 days. The system shall include a 12.8 V/24 Ah battery with an integrated Battery Management System (BMS) and a 12 V/5 A solar charge controller with necessary protection and battery management features. The system shall be mounted on a GI pole of 6 m height and 60 mm diameter. The photovoltaic (PV) module/solar panel shall have a minimum power output of 80 Wp and shall be of monocrystalline silicon type. The scope shall include all necessary fixtures, fittings, cables/leads, lifting and installation machinery, labour, transportation, testing and commissioning charges, complete in all respects, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge
